description: This file contains JavaScript code extending CKEDITOR's HTML parser to handle pasting content from Word, including functions for list creation, style filtering, and cleaning Word-specific markup.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.fragment
classes.description: Prototype extension for handling HTML fragment parsing.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.element
classes.description: Prototype extension for handling HTML element parsing.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.filter
classes.description: HTML parser filter used in cleaning Word content.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.htmlParser.basicWriter
classes.description: Writer class for converting HTML fragments to HTML string.

methods.name: onlyChild
methods.description: Returns the only child element if exactly one exists, otherwise null.

methods.name: removeAnyChildWithName
methods.description: Removes all children with a specific name and returns them.

methods.name: getAncestor
methods.description: Finds the closest ancestor matching a given name or pattern.

methods.name: firstChild
methods.description: Finds the first child element matching a predicate function.

methods.name: addStyle
methods.description: Adds inline style to an element, handling string or object input.
